test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What distance will be covered in 14 minutes by an auto rickshaw moving at 42 km/h?
solution:
Given:

Time = 14 minutes

Speed = 42 km/h

Concept used:

1. Distance = Speed × Time

2. 60 minutes = 1 hour

Calculation:

The distance covered in 14 minutes

⇒ 42 × 14/60

⇒ 9.8 km

**∴ 9.8 km distance will be covered in 14 minutes by an auto rickshaw moving at 42 km/h.**
